paper.title_en: The NANOGrav 15-year data set: A Limit on Continuous Spin Gravitons
paper.abstract_en: Continuous spin particles (CSPs) are massless particles characterized by a dimensionful spin scale, $ρ$, which, when non-zero, changes their helicity under Lorentz boosts. Since CSPs reduce to ordinary particles when $ρ\rightarrow 0$, the photon or graviton could be CSPs and only appear to behave as ordinary particles due to a small value of $ρ$. Therefore, it is important to determine what value of $ρ$ is experimentally allowed. Recent work has shown that the physical effects of CSPs scale as powers of $ρ/ω$ when $ρ\ll ω$, where $ω$ is a frequency scale, making low-frequency probes particularly beneficial for highlighting these phenomena. In this paper we use pulsar timing arrays to set constraints on the spin scale of the continuous spin graviton. Pulsar timing arrays are uniquely suited for this application as they have exceptional sensitivity to low, nanohertz frequency gravitational waves, as demonstrated by their recent evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave background. Using standard Bayesian data analysis techniques, we find that the NANOGrav 15-year data set constrains the graviton spin scale to $ρ_\text{g} < 1.23 \times 10^{-23} \, \text{eV} $ at the 95% credible level.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 利用NANOGrav 15年脉冲星计时阵列数据对连续自旋引力子的自旋标度给出贝叶斯上限，将CSP唯象学与PTA低频引力波观测结合，物理动机清晰、方法明确、结论具体，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: NANOGrav 15年数据集：对连续自旋引力子的限制
decision.abstract_zh: 连续自旋粒子（CSPs）是一类无质量粒子，由一个具有量纲的自旋标度 $\rho$ 刻画；当该标度非零时，它们在洛伦兹助推下螺旋度会发生改变。由于当 $\rho\rightarrow 0$ 时CSPs退化为普通粒子，光子或引力子本身可能是CSPs，只是由于 $\rho$ 很小而看起来表现得像普通粒子。因此，确定实验上允许的 $\rho$ 取值很重要。近期工作表明，当 $\rho\ll \omega$ 时，CSPs的物理效应按 $\rho/\omega$ 的幂次标度，其中 $\omega$ 是一个频率标度，这使得低频探测特别有利于凸显这些现象。在本文中，我们使用脉冲星计时阵列对连续自旋引力子的自旋标度施加限制。脉冲星计时阵列特别适合这一应用，因为它们对低频、纳赫兹频率的引力波具有极高的灵敏度，这已由它们近期给出的随机引力波背景证据所证明。采用标准的贝叶斯数据分析技术，我们发现NANOGrav 15年数据集在95%可信水平上将引力子自旋标度限制为 $\rho_\text{g} < 1.23 \times 10^{-23} \, \text{eV}$。
